content.title: KTB Q3 Deep Dive: Helly Hansen Integration, Margin Compression, and Mixed Brand Momentum
content.summary: Clothing company Kontoor Brands (NYSE:KTB) met Wall Streets revenue expectations in Q3 CY2025, with sales up 27.3% year on year to $853.2 million. The company’s outlook for the full year was close to analysts’ estimates with revenue guided to $3.11 billion at the midpoint. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.44 per share was 3.2% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
